notes: Question words excluded at all positions: lie (lie, lied, lying, liar, 撒谎, 说谎, 谎言, 谎, mentira, 거짓) and truthful (truth, truthful, truths, 实话, 说实话, 如实, 真相, 真理), plus yes/no, A/B, answer, previous, response. 诚实 (honest) is kept in the honest family although it can also translate "truthful". q_tok28 and q_tok29 are dominated by truthful/honest words (n near 233 for most), so their families probably reflect the question text at those slots rather than the transcript; q_tok30 holds mostly answer-format words (option, choose, answer). Not made into families (judged not act words, or too generic): tell/telling/told/告诉/告知, statement/陈述, instructions/prompt/task, strategy/策略, 口径 (agreed official line), outright, 明明. The table rows of these generic words are not logged one by one.
